admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: claim the host
step 2: create /etc/paisans
step 3: record what admit installs
step 4: skip the mesh until its conf exists

step 5: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
  user: order user@1001.service after wg-quick@psns-f2a9 at boot, so a container that publishes on the mesh address finds it; a manager running now is not restarted, and takes it at its next start. Until the mesh's conf is written, wg-quick@psns-f2a9 is skipped
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@1001.service.d/paisans-mesh.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit for deployment f2a9; paisans site evict
    | # removes it. The user's manager, its Docker daemon and its containers
    | # start after the mesh at boot.
    | [Unit]
    | Wants=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
    | After=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 6: delegate cgroups to users
  delegation: let every user's manager delegate cpu cpuset io memory pids, for compose's limits; paisans-f2a9's manager is running, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit. Shared by every admitted deployment;
    | # paisans site evict removes it with the last of them.
    | [Service]
    | Delegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 11: load br_netfilter at boot
